articles.title: Based on the MaxEnt model the analysis of influencing factors and simulation of potential risk areas of human infection with avian influenza A (H7N9) in China.
articles.journal: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology

related_surveillance.method: high-confidence article geography intersected with GIDS series coverage
high-confidence article geography intersected with GIDS series coverage

en.research_question: The study seeks to identify environmental and demographic drivers associated with human H7N9 infections and to map historical risk zones across China.
en.study_design: Researchers applied a MaxEnt computational framework to analyze case locations alongside environmental and socioeconomic datasets spanning five years.
en.population_setting: The analysis focused on human cases reported throughout China, with particular attention to coastal provinces during the 2013 through 2017 timeframe.
en.main_findings: Model outputs indicate a steady annual escalation in infection probability, consistently highlighting eastern and southeastern coastal regions as persistent hotspots. Demographic concentration served as the strongest predictor, while ecological and agricultural metrics provided secondary explanatory power. Simulated risk distributions demonstrated strong agreement with documented outbreak locations.
en.public_health_relevance: Mapping these spatial trends and variable contributions may help guide resource allocation for targeted monitoring and intervention planning.
en.limitations: The authors acknowledge that expanding the dataset with additional variables is necessary to enhance predictive precision and strengthen policy guidance.
en.gids_interpretation: This work functions as a retrospective geospatial assessment that contextualizes historical H7N9 distribution patterns and their associated correlates, rather than providing an active monitoring mechanism.

zh.research_question: 本研究旨在探讨中国人群感染禽流感A(H7N9)病毒的相关影响因素及其传播特征，并评估潜在的高风险地理区域。
zh.study_design: 该研究采用MaxEnt算法进行回顾性空间建模，利用2013至2017年的病例点位与环境及社会经济数据进行相关性检验。
zh.population_setting: 研究聚焦于中国境内报告过H7N9确诊病例的地理范围，时间跨度覆盖2013年至2017年。
zh.main_findings: 模型模拟显示疫情风险呈逐年上升态势，东部与东南部沿海地带持续处于高风险区间。人口密度被识别为核心关联变量，植被覆盖、降水、海拔、家禽屠宰规模、产值及气温等亦为次要相关因素。模拟生成的风险分布图与实际疫情记录高度吻合。
zh.public_health_relevance: 明确关键关联变量与高风险地理分布可为公共卫生部门优化监测网络布局及资源配置提供科学参考。
zh.limitations: 作者明确指出当前模型纳入的变量集较为有限，未来需补充更多参数以提升预测精度并增强对防控策略的指导价值。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该文提供的是基于历史数据的回顾性空间风险评估背景信息，侧重于环境与社会经济变量的关联性分析，未涉及实时监测信号的直接验证或前瞻性预警。

articles.title: [Trends and Epidemiological Characteristics of Acute Hepatitis B among Foreign Nationals in the Republic of Korea, 2014-2024].

en.research_question: The study investigates how acute hepatitis B reporting patterns and demographic profiles differ between Korean citizens and foreign residents within South Korea over an eleven-year period.
en.study_design: This research utilizes retrospective analysis of national infectious disease surveillance records and epidemiological investigation data spanning from 2014 through 2024.
en.population_setting: The analysis encompassed 3,591 confirmed acute hepatitis B cases reported across South Korea, specifically comparing domestic residents with international visitors and migrants.
en.main_findings: While overall reporting rates and geographic spread mirrored each other, age distributions diverged significantly, with foreign nationals skewing younger than local patients. The majority of international cases originated from Asian nations with elevated baseline infection rates, and most individuals worked in manual labor sectors. Clinically, jaundice was the predominant presentation, though vaccination records were frequently unavailable and communication hurdles complicated field assessments.
en.public_health_relevance: The rising influx of international residents highlights the necessity for targeted disease control initiatives within the host country. Identifying gaps in immunization documentation and addressing potential barriers to medical access can inform more effective community-based prevention programs.
en.limitations: Administrative reporting mechanisms may yield incomplete case capture when individuals encounter restricted medical access. Furthermore, the frequent unavailability of verifiable immunization documentation and persistent communication hurdles during field assessments restrict comprehensive risk evaluation.
en.gids_interpretation: This report offers longitudinal epidemiological tracking data concerning viral hepatitis patterns within a specific host nation. It establishes a foundational reference for analyzing demographic shifts in disease incidence and informs broader discussions on managing health metrics across transient populations.

zh.research_question: 本研究旨在对比2014至2024年韩国本土居民与外籍人士急性乙型肝炎的报告趋势及流行病学特征。
zh.study_design: 研究基于国家传染病监测系统数据，采用描述性分析方法对十年间的确诊病例进行回顾性统计。
zh.population_setting: 分析对象为韩国境内报告的急性乙型肝炎患者，核心关注点为外籍感染人群及其来源地分布。
zh.main_findings: 外籍患者的发病年龄普遍早于本土居民，且主要来源于乙肝高流行率的亚洲地区。多数感染者处于非熟练劳动状态，黄疸为常见症状，但免疫接种记录普遍缺失，流调过程常遇语言沟通困难。
zh.public_health_relevance: 鉴于外籍常住人口数量上升，该群体在传染病防控体系中占据重要位置。明确其免疫空白状况有助于规划定向的健康促进项目。
zh.limitations: 文献明确指出外籍人员的疫苗接种史大多难以核实，且部分人群可能因就医渠道有限而未被完全纳入统计。现场调查阶段亦面临语言障碍制约。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该文章记录了特定时间段内跨境人群的疾病谱系变化，为理解流动人口在区域卫生数据中的呈现方式提供了背景资料。其分类指标可辅助后续文献检索与主题聚类。
